description: Mann-Whitney U test comparing NCBI plasmid fraction (n_plasmid/n_total) between double-signal and background resistance KOs. Filtered to genes with >= 50 total NCBI nuccore hits. Genes absent from NCBI (gesA n=1, gesB n=1, nrsD n=16) are excluded. plasmid[Filter] search in nuccore is sequence-based, not AMR-database-based.
plsdb_api_note: PLSDB filter_nuccore uses CARD/AMRFinder annotations. gesA/gesB/nrsD/aoxB return 0 due to AMR database gaps, not true chromosomal location.
caveats: PLSDB AMR filter confounded: CARD/AMRFinder does not cover gesA, gesB, nrsD, aoxB — zeros reflect database gaps, not true plasmid absence.
MGnify/geNomad plasmid set (1,053 contigs) is environmentally biased: mercury/gold/arsenite resistance plasmids are predominantly clinical/industrial.
NCBI test underpowered: only 3 double-signal resistance KOs have n_total >= 50 (merD, norB, aoxB). gesA/gesB absent from NCBI. Result driven by merD.
golS (K19592) has high D=0.26 and low lambda=0.13 but plasmid_frac=1.7e-5 — a gold-sensing regulator, not a resistance effector; HGT may have occurred chromosomally rather than via plasmids.
Fisher threshold test (threshold=median background): [[3,0],[25,26]], OR=inf, p=0.132 — not significant.

bvbrc_validation.description: Independent validation using BV-BRC (PATRIC) reference genomes. For each gene, genome_feature accessions are matched against genome_sequences with "plasmid" in the NCBI description (84,446 plasmid sequences). PATRIC annotations only (not RefSeq). Filtered to genes with >= 50 BV-BRC features.
bvbrc_validation.convergence_note: NCBI Entrez (p=0.045, n_double=3) and BV-BRC (p=0.044, n_double=2, deduplicated) give consistent marginal significance from independent databases. Result driven primarily by merD; golS near-zero in both.
bvbrc_validation.deduplication_note: arsC has two KO IDs (K00537, K03741) with identical BV-BRC counts. Deduplicated to 48 background KOs (keeping row with larger n). p changes from 0.047 to 0.044 — result is robust to this choice.
bvbrc_validation.background_composition_note: Background includes genuinely plasmid-associated genes (pcoB 6.8%, merA 4.5%, tetA 4.1%) that fail double-signal criteria: pcoB/tetA have D < 0.2 (phylogenetically structured distribution despite plasmid carriage); merA has lambda=0.527 > 0.3 (phylogenetic signal present at genus level). Their presence in background makes the test conservative — p=0.044 is achieved despite merD (7.19%) being only marginally higher than pcoB (6.8%).
